title.zh: SpaceX拟融资400亿美元采购英伟达芯片，Apollo牵头安排
title.en: SpaceX拟融资400亿美元采购英伟达芯片，Apollo牵头安排

current_state.zh: SpaceX is reportedly arranging roughly $40 billion in financing led by Apollo Global Management — including about $10 billion of bank loans and $30 billion of investment-grade debt — to purchase Nvidia chips and expand its AI compute buildout, with Pimco among the lenders in talks.
